area_overview: EntityEntry as the per-entity control surface: state, entity object, metadata, current/original/database values, property/member APIs, navigation APIs, Query(), Reload, and GetDatabaseValues.
key_ideas: ChangeTracker.Entries returns EntityEntry objects; R02 focuses on what each EntityEntry exposes.
EntityEntry.State is the per-entity state EF will use for SaveChanges.
EntityEntry.Entity is the actual CLR object; Metadata describes the EF model type.
CurrentValues are the in-memory values EF will save; OriginalValues are the snapshot EF uses for change detection and concurrency.
Property/Properties give per-scalar-property value and IsModified control.
Reference/Collection/Navigation APIs expose navigation entries, Load/LoadAsync, IsLoaded, and Query().
Entry.Query() on collection/reference navigations gives a query for the related data before loading it.
Reload refreshes the entity from the database; GetDatabaseValues fetches database values without blindly overwriting current values.
SetValues can copy values from DTOs, objects, dictionaries, or database values into CurrentValues/OriginalValues.
